# PixelRyu

> PixelRyu is a solo Japanese indie game studio making small, polished, fully multilingual (12-language) mobile games for Android and iOS.

PixelRyu (屋号: PixelRyu) is an independent developer based in Japan. This site is a multilingual portfolio (en, ja, zh, ko, hi, id, de, fr, it, es, pt, ru) with a page per game, plus a privacy policy and terms of service for each game. Language is selected client-side; English is the default content.

## Games

- [ISSEN (一閃)](https://pixelryu.github.io/issen/): A sumi-e (ink-wash) timing-action game built on the iaido draw — breathe, read the distance, unleash one perfect cut. In development for Android & iOS.
- [HOTARU (The Lost House)](https://pixelryu.github.io/hotaru/): A quiet, atmospheric first-person Japanese horror walking simulator set in a lost house. Android & iOS.
- [Liquid Glow](https://pixelryu.github.io/liquid-glow/): A cozy, minimalist indie sort puzzle from Japan — arrange flowing liquid colors. Android.
- [Mole Whack (モグラぽかぽか)](https://pixelryu.github.io/mole-whack/): A casual stage-based whack-a-mole tap game across 100 stages — hit the moles, clear the target, advance. Android & iOS.
